_source: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Chapter 7, Table 19 'Typical soil water characteristics for different soil types'. TEW given for Ze = 0.10 m. Ranges as printed. Used ONLY as a DEMO soil assumption when no site soil profile exists (site soil comes from M3, decision D8).
_notes_added_d15: sand, loamy_sand, silty_clay_loam, silty_clay and clay were added for user-built rotations (D15) from the same Table 19 (values as printed online; silty clay theta_fc is printed '0-30 - 0.42', read as 0.30-0.42). annex7_class: coarse = sand and loamy sand (Fig. 30a); the finer classes use the medium/fine formula of Fig. 30b. tr55_hsg follows TR-55 Appendix A (A: sand, loamy sand, sandy loam; B: silt loam, loam; D: silty clay loam, silty clay, clay). sandy_clay_loam, clay_loam and sandy_clay have NO row in FAO-56 Table 19, so their water-content ranges are null (never invented); site runs take AWC from the soil profile, so those ranges are not needed, and only demo_soil() would need them. Their hydrologic groups are read from the TR-55 Appendix A texture table (verified in the document text: A sand, loamy sand, sandy loam; B silt loam or loam; C sandy clay loam; D clay loam, silty clay loam, sandy clay, silty clay, clay). Silt is NOT added: TR-55 does not list it. A farm with a silt texture cannot be simulated; the run says so.
_notes: annex7_class follows the FAO-56 Chapter 6 text for Fig. 30b (medium = sandy loam, loam, silt loam, silt). tr55_hsg follows the TR-55 Appendix A texture table for disturbed profiles (A = sand, loamy sand, sandy loam; B = silt loam, loam); a real hydrologic soil group must come from the soil survey.
